title: Truce of Andrusovo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Truce of Andrusovo", at revision 1375162538, opens: "The Truce of Andrusovo established a thirteen-and-a-half year truce, signed on 9 February [O.S. 30 January] 1667 between the Tsardom of Russia and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which had fought the Russo-Polish War since 1654." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q721168, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peace treaty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
